content:
alice: quick heads-up — after the kernel-selector rollout that prefers ALiBi-optimized kernels, we see a 15-25% tail latency regression on qwen2.5 for multilingual workloads (JP/AR). Repro steps below, but suspect rope-scaling + tokenizer differences causing wrong kernel path + kv-head mismatch.

ben: dug into traces on staging. short summary: many requests get routed to the fast_mha_alibi kernel initially but then fallback to generic_cublas when the KV shapes / head params don't match what the kernel expects. kv cache hit rate low (~0.18) on affected runs. stack trace/log snippet: 

```
[2026-03-17 12:04:23] model=qwen2p5 seq=128 selected_kernel=fast_mha_alibi kernel_version=1.3
[2026-03-17 12:04:23] tokenizer=sentencepiece_multi lang=ja merge_count=32000 effective_tokens=110
[2026-03-17 12:04:24] runtime: kv_head_dim=64 attention_heads=32 expected_kv_heads=16 -> mismatch
[2026-03-17 12:04:24] fallback: selected_kernel=generic_cuBLAS_reduce kernel_version=0.9
[2026-03-17 12:04:24] perf: p50=18ms p95=112ms p99=276ms (baseline p99 ~220ms)
```

carla: config we used for the selector, fyi. note rope_scale_threshold is new.

```
kernel_selector:
  prefer_alibi_for_rope: true
  rope_scale_threshold: 0.8
  kv_head_match_tolerance: 0.05
  batching:
    mode: latency_sensitive
    max_batch_tokens: 4096
```

carla: also seeing tokenizer edgecase — for CJK the sentencepiece outputs more short tokens, shifts positions such that RoPE scaling assumptions differ vs latin. result: kernel fast_mha_alibi assumes head_dim/kv alignment derived from quantized layout; mismatch triggers slow fallback.

dan: agree. hypothesis: our kernel-selection checks only validate model.arch and seq_len but not tokenizer-inferred head partitioning or actual kv_head_dim after quantization. quick repro curl: 

```
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"qwen2.5","input":"今日は良い天気ですね。","batch_size":4,"tracing":true}'
```

ben: added a tiny instrument to runtime that dumps `kv_layout` and `kernel_expectation` before selection. sample output: 

```
kv_layout: {kv_head_dim:64, kv_heads:32, kv_blob_dtype: int8}
kernel_expectation: {kernel=fast_mha_alibi, expects: {kv_heads:16, head_dim:128}}
```

ben: that explains fallback — kernel expects different partitioning. seems like some models have mixed head/kv splits after quantization and our kernel registry didn't map those variants.

carla: quick mitigation: lower `rope_scale_threshold` to 0.6 and add runtime guard to require `kv_head_match_tolerance >= 0.15` before selecting ALiBi kernel. also a temporary route to pin qwen2.5->generic_mha for multi-lang routes. config patch: 

```
kernel_selector:
  rope_scale_threshold: 0.6
  kv_head_match_tolerance: 0.15
  prefer_alibi_for_rope: true
```

eva: fwiw tokenizer team confirmed sentencepiece merges cause longer effective positions in some CJK samples. that can push RoPE scale into a different regime at inference because our positional embedding normalization assumes latin token counts. may need a tokenizer-aware rope scaling correction in the compiler.

eva: short-term test I ran: forcing `rope_scale=1.0` at compile time for qwen2.5 eliminates the fallback and recovers p99 almost to baseline. not a final fix but confirms rope scaling is a major factor.

perf-bot: automated A/B probes show rollback->kernel_selector_v1 reduces p99 by ~30ms on affected test set. probe id=ab_20260317_07.

alice: proposal — three workstreams: 1) runtime: add kv_layout -> kernel mapping check (strict) + safer fallback metrics, 2) infra: add tokenizer-variant test harness in perf CI (JP/AR/CN), 3) compiler: add tokenizer-aware rope scaling option and expose as `rope_scale_override` per model. thoughts?

ben: +1. i'll own (1) and push kernel registry tests. i'll also add a metric for `kernel_fallback_rate` per model/region.

carla: I'll own (2) with devex — spinning up a small suite of multilingual prompts and automated traces. want to catch this early on PRs.

dan: I'll prototype (3) — but compiler change may take longer. will try a minimal flag `--rope-scale=1.0` to validate.

alice: plan sounds good. immediate action: rollback kernel-selector rollout in staging to v0.9 as deploy-bot suggests, and disable ALiBi preference until we have kv mapping guard. deploy-bot, please roll back staging selector.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated: kernel-selector -> v0.9 on staging. eta 5m. :thumbsup:

alice: thanks. let's sync tomorrow EOD with short perf digest. add any logs to this thread. :rocket:
